title: Chapter 1042
paragraphs: Chapter 1042
Episode 249. The First Deployment of the Plutonian (9)
Right after Ban finished speaking, Luke swiftly closed the distance between them.
His great sword, tainted by lightning energy, was slowly falling towards Ban's head. The dull sword, transcending senses and cognition, sliced the space between Ban and Luke.
It was impossible to dodge in the distorted space. The moment one touched it, the sword energy filling the inside would tear everything to shreds.
Yet, Ban casually stepped into the distorted space with her light footwork.
For Luke, it was an unprecedented experience. None of his previous opponents, even if they were gods, had directly entered a collapsed space like Ban.
This was also true during the rescue mission of Airan. Jin had countered the space collapsed by the dull sword with his own sword.
“Pretending to be almighty… It’s not even funny.”
Crack-!
As Ban moved, the distorted spaces retreated in response to her speed. They were pushed back, unable to withstand the force she emitted.
In other words, Ban was purely countering Luke's dull sword and space collapse with her strength. It was a method of counteraction Luke had never considered before.
“I'll warn you just once. Luke, today is your last day to fight. Confront me with your whole body and full strength, not with these trivial techniques. Try to enforce any part of your will on me.”
The space broken by the dull sword was gathering in front of Luke. His face blurred due to the broken spaces.
Luke struck down at the center again. This time, it wasn’t a dull sword but an extremely fast and destructive blow.
The broken spaces regained their original form with that strike.
He barely concealed his astonishment. He had suspected Ban might be stronger than himself, but he thought the difference would be marginal.

'Considering the aftermath of the Laprarosa Liberation War, she must have sustained considerable injuries, and even before coming here, she had captured Nirgand... Yet, she is unbelievably strong, reminding me of the moment when Kinzelo's fragment manifested.'
The fighting spirit that used to burn in his heart in his youth when facing a strong enemy was stirring again. That same spirit that had turned many impossibilities into possibilities.
But to Ban, even that seemed laughably trivial.
“Ah, was it too difficult a request for a rotten ghost?”
Sigmund drew in a flash.
From left to right, the lightning energy that slid along the blade drew a sharp blue line in the center of the battlefield, followed by a blast of wind that shook the entire sanctuary.

Luke spread his sword energy similarly, closing the distance with Ban again. However, the more he broke through her lightning energy, the more powerfully it constricted him, and the distance did not close easily.
It felt like chasing an illusion. Though only swords and lightning energy existed between them, it felt like wandering a maze filled with tricks.

“It’s been a long time since you’ve struggled to achieve something, Luke. That’s because you've abandoned the true meaning of struggle. Relying on the power of a great being is fundamentally a very easy task.”
Zip-!
A ray of light escaping from the clashing energies grazed Ban’s cheek.
“It's easy if all you do is borrow power. But I've been fighting to revive him. For a long time, never once forgetting my dream.”
“Dreams…”
Ban wiped the blood trickling down her cheek and shook her head.

“Holding onto dreams is something allowed for the living. You, who should have died and decayed long ago, keep talking about dreams and such nonsense, making the world more chaotic than it was a thousand years ago.”
“Isn’t that also your story? Battle God Ban, you too should have disappeared half a millennium ago.”
“I and my brothers will leave when our time ends, so no need to worry.”
Luke’s sword reaching Ban first was meaningless. Instead, Luke realized the immense gap between himself and Ban the moment he slashed her cheek.
They couldn’t be considered ‘the same Chansung’. Luke had just forcibly broken the balance to lead the fight into chaos.
His judgment was that the greater the chaos in battle, the more the gap would blur. However, Ban had completely blocked his tactics with just a slight cut on her cheek.
The battle was clearly becoming more orderly.
Their swords were always where they needed to be, their movements were directed to predetermined spaces, and clashes occurred only at the designated moments.
That was why Ban wanted to fight this way.
Even if Luke had fallen, he was still a Genesis, so it was most efficient for Ban to suppress variables and fight.
Therefore, she forced the enemy’s movements as needed, occasionally inflicting small wounds for this purpose.
This was Ban’s way of confronting Luke. A method only possible from a position that had transcended the state of Genesis and achieved a much higher level of martial arts.
Blue swords like wings sprouted behind Luke. It was the Plutonian Battle God  Sword Technique, the Thunder God Sword.

The Sun God Religion's first temple was still protected from the flames by Luke’s guarding area. Naturally, this area shrank with the start of the battle, and now only the central sanctuary with the statue of the Sun God and its immediate vicinity remained intact.
Luke seemed determined to protect it at all costs, but obviously, Ban had no intention of allowing that.
“Luke, a person who ascended to God and established the Thunder God Sword. However, none of us use that sword now. It’s outdated.”
The blades of the Thunder God Sword were fiercely attacking Ban.
To those who couldn’t keep up with its speed, it would appear only as dozens of flashes of light, flickering in and out of existence.
But Ban completely understood the Thunder God Sword. With just a step or two, she easily dodged its attacks.

“So your claim of not having forgotten your dream is a lie. If it were true, your sword now should have differed from what I studied and learned in my youth when you achieved greatness. Like water that stagnates and rots when its flow stops, so does your sword.”
Sigmund stabbed into the void.
However, what appeared to be empty space was actually the core of the Thunder God Sword, and Luke’s great sword immediately lost its bearing.
Of course, this didn’t mean Luke’s martial prowess was diminished, but his secret technique had collapsed to a simple thrust.
And now, the way Ban had dismantled the Thunder God Sword, Luke did not know. Not in his lifetime, nor even now as the High Priest of the Sun God Religion.
“The sword that eliminates all the fatal weaknesses of your secret technique, that’s the Plutonian Domination Sword. You must have experienced it once through Brother Jin.”
Ban’s eyes began to blaze blue.
Plutonian Battle God Sword Technique, 10th Sword
Plutonian Domination Sword – Open
“I'll show you again, for you to know the glory.”
The air grows heavier.
A blue whirlwind infused with lightning energy quickly enveloped the sanctuary, swirling around the entire burning first temple outside.
‘Is this… the result of evolving the Thunder God Sword?’
It resembled it.

The Plutonian Domination Sword that began in front of Luke now, clearly resembled the Thunder God Sword. The process of unleashing the lightning energy, the direction the sword moved, the way the user dominated the space – all of it.
When facing Jin in the underworld, Luke had not felt this sensation. The Plutonian Domination Sword displayed by Jin had no resemblance to the Thunder God Sword.
Yet the swords wielded by Jin and Ban were the same. This unexplainable sensation briefly confused Luke's mind.

“Even if one is a Genesis, in the end, a sword is a tool wielded by a person, and swordsmanship is merely a method to kill. Despite being resurrected with the power of the Sun God, you did not advance that method, instead being ensnared by the illusion of not losing your fighting spirit, solely because you are a Genesis.”
How could one who had not advanced even a single sword technique in all this time claim to complete the world?
Ban’s lips curled into a sneer as she continued.
“Putting everything aside, if you defeat me, then your words will become true. Try to break this sword.”
Luke roared and charged at Ban.

Suddenly, he formed a new Thunder God Sword around his body like armor, with blue blades, and his brilliantly shining great sword seemed capable of splitting the sky, as all who reached Genesis could.
Yet again, he couldn’t close the distance as he wished.
Despite his legs moving forward, Ban still seemed far away, and the sword energy shot forward from the blade disappeared before reaching her, vanishing somewhere in the air.
The Plutonian Domination Sword had no weaknesses.
At least, that's how it appeared to Luke. He frantically scanned the surroundings, trying to break down the Plutonian Domination Sword first, but could find no weaknesses.
“Where are your brothers, with whom you once roamed the world, Luke?”
Her words pierced Luke's heart like a knife.
Fzzt, crack!
A bolt of lightning struck the statue from somewhere. The statue, which had remained unscathed, turned into a pile of broken stones, and Luke couldn’t look back at it.
It was because Ban had closed the distance between them. Luke tried to step carefully, but Ban's sword was already piercing his shoulder.
A chunk of flesh fell to the floor. Had he been a little later, it would have been fragments of his heart of light rolling on the ground instead.
Luke swung his great sword composedly, but Ban was no longer there.
Once again, Sigmund scraped Luke’s chest. Within the blue mist of the Plutonian Domination Sword, Ban appeared and disappeared like a shadow. Luke could neither keep up with nor predict her speed.
“If they had been here, this sword would appear less perfect in your eyes. You were strongest when they were with you. You should have chosen them, not the Sun God.”
The lightning energy of the Plutonian Domination Sword grew brighter, while Luke’s vision continued to darken.
